# Configuration Schema Documentation

This document describes the structure and data types of the top-level keys in `config.json`.

## Top-Level Keys

| Key | Data Type | Description |
|-----|-----------|-------------|
| `app_name` | String | The name of the application |
| `version` | String | The version number of the application in semantic versioning format (major.minor.patch) |
| `debug` | Boolean | Flag to enable or disable debug mode for the application |
| `port` | Number (Integer) | The port number on which the application server listens |
| `timeout` | Number (Float) | The timeout duration in seconds for operations |
| `database` | Object | Configuration object containing database connection settings and credentials |
| `features` | Array | List of enabled features in the application |
| `allowed_origins` | Array | List of allowed origin URLs for CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) |
| `max_connections` | Number (Integer) | Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed |
| `enable_ssl` | Boolean | Flag to enable or disable SSL/TLS encryption |
| `log_level` | String | The logging level for the application (e.g., INFO, DEBUG, ERROR) |

## Detailed Type Information

### Primitive Types
- **String**: Text values (e.g., `app_name`, `version`, `log_level`)
- **Number**: Numeric values, including both integers and floats (e.g., `port`, `timeout`, `max_connections`)
- **Boolean**: True/false values (e.g., `debug`, `enable_ssl`)

### Complex Types
- **Object**: `database` - A nested object containing database configuration with properties like `host`, `port`, `name`, and `credentials`
- **Array**: `features` and `allowed_origins` - Collections of string values

## Notes
- The `database` object contains nested properties including a `credentials` sub-object
- Array elements are homogeneous (all strings in both `features` and `allowed_origins`)
- Numeric values include both integers (port, max_connections) and floating-point numbers (timeout)
